description: This file contains schema definitions, validation functions, and API schema components for datasets in the Superset project, including classes for dataset schemas, validation, and related objects.

classes.name: DatasetColumnsPutSchema
classes.description: Schema for updating dataset columns, including validation for date formats and field properties.

classes.name: DatasetMetricCurrencyPutSchema
classes.description: Schema for dataset metric currency information.

classes.name: CurrencyField
classes.description: Custom nested field that handles legacy string payloads for currency data.

classes.name: DatasetMetricsPutSchema
classes.description: Schema for dataset metrics, including expression, description, and currency.

classes.name: FolderSchema

classes.name: DatasetPostSchema

classes.name: DatasetPutSchema
classes.description: Schema for updating dataset properties, including validation and error handling.

classes.name: DatasetDuplicateSchema

classes.name: DatasetRelatedChart

classes.name: DatasetRelatedObjectsResponse

classes.name: ImportMetricCurrencySchema

classes.name: ImportV1MetricSchema

classes.name: ImportV1DatasetSchema

classes.name: DatasetCacheWarmUpResponseSchema
classes.description: Schema for list of cache warm-up statuses.

classes.description: Schema for drill info on dataset columns.

classes.name: UserSchema
